Name: Anak
Summary: Anak was the forefather of the Anakim, the tall people of Canaan whose size frightened the ten spies.
KeyStory: The spies reported the sons of Anak in Hebron, and Israel felt like grasshoppers beside them — but Caleb still urged them to go up at once.
RelatedPeople: Ahiman, Son of Anak; Sheshai, Son of Anak; Talmai, Son of Anak; Caleb; Joshua
LifeLesson: Giants look smaller to those who remember who promised the land.
